item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**:

- **Range:** Base heating setpoints span **55°F–80°F**, before any setback or offset.
- **Data source:** The distribution is constructed from **U.S. EIA 2020 Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) microdata**.
- **55°F meaning:** It identifies a **vacant housing unit**, recorded as Tenure = “Not Available.” All units assigned a 55°F heating setpoint are vacant.

Source: [ResStock 2025 Release 1 Technical Reference Guide, “Heating Setpoint,” Tables 99–100](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf).
